purpose: Authorize a fourth future-only 32-image image-bound v3 E2 lineage from the remaining rebuilt prescreen-v2 pool after the third lineage closed with insufficient collection winners.

evidence.result: After R0/R1/R2 delivery closure, 29 groups were selected and three were confirmed collection quality rejects (two open-zh-disease and one option-en-disease).
evidence.phase_barrier_decision: No rewrite was submitted because a campaign with fewer than 32 selected collection winners cannot satisfy the immutable exact-32 conversion qualification.
evidence.remaining_pool: 224 candidates, 28 per fixed cell, after excluding nine source lineages under image/source/near-duplicate identity.

future_only_changes.source_selection: Freeze exactly four fresh identities per fixed cell from prescreen-v2, excluding all nine preceding source lineages under image/source/near-duplicate identities.

qualification: Only a 32-winner collection can enter the rewrite phase. Confirmed collection or rewrite quality rejections remain terminal, and SFT remains separately unauthorized.
